title: Hearth
subtitle: Alexa+ add-on, running in the Countertop simulator
headline: Care for Mom from anywhere, by voice.
intro: June talks to her kitchen display. Her daughter Maya checks in from her phone. Both are talking to one Hearth MCP server, so reminders, refills and worries reach the right person.

story.title: Morning medicine time
story.note: The server pushes a reminder and June's display speaks up on its own.

story.title: June logs a pill
story.say: I just took my blood pressure pill

story.title: She forgets and asks again
story.say: Did I take the pink one? I might take another
story.note: Hearth tells her not to take a second dose.

story.title: What is this pill for?
story.say: What is the white oval one for?
story.note: Answered from the FDA drug label.

story.title: Running low
story.say: I'm almost out of metformin, can you order more?
story.note: Say or tap yes on the display to confirm the order.

story.title: June mentions a fall
story.say: I fell getting out of my chair this morning but I'm okay
story.note: Maya's phone is alerted right away.

story.title: Maya replies
story.say: Let Mom know I'll call her at 6
